usage: 椰汁糕 is used as a noun to describe a type of sweet dim sum made from coconut milk and sugar.
You can use 椰汁糕 to refer to the dish when ordering at a dim sum restaurant or talking about dessert choices.
椰汁糕 can appear with quantifiers, like '一件椰汁糕' (one piece of coconut pudding cake).
It can be combined with adjectives to describe its qualities, for example, '甜嘅椰汁糕' means sweet coconut pudding cake.
椰汁糕 is mostly found in food contexts and is rarely used metaphorically.
